title: Artifact Manifest v1
description: Structural schema for one ArtifactManifest entry. See docs/bible/08-alchemist/178-artifact-manifest-contract.md. No unified manifest aggregating all artifact types exists today — the closest CURRENT analogue is the per-component preview_manifest (backend/jewelmind/preview/mesh.py) for PREVIEW_MESH only.

filename.description: CURRENT: sanitize_filename(project.name) + extension, computed at the API layer, never persisted server-side beyond one response.

byteSize.description: PLANNED — not currently reported anywhere; a caller only learns file size from the HTTP Content-Length header, not a structured field.

generationDuration.description: PLANNED — no per-artifact timing is recorded today; only overall geometry generation_duration_s exists.
